title: Cases of Undeclared Peanut Allergens in Food Products
what_it_is: Cases of Undeclared Peanut Allergens in Food Products

sections.label: Undeclared peanut allergen cases
sections.summary: From 2015 to 2018 there were no cases of undeclared peanut allergen in prepacked food products, and since 2019 there have been five, all from overseas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (a) to date, how many cases of undeclared peanut allergens have been found in food products sold in Singapore; and (b) whether any adverse health effects associated with peanut allergy have been noted from these or other cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: These include labelling requirements where food manufacturers and traders must ensure that known allergens, such as peanuts, which are found in prepacked food products, are declared on the labels of the products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: From 2015 to 2018, there were no cases of undeclared peanut allergen in prepacked food products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since 2019, there have been five cases of undeclared peanut allergen in prepacked food products.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Upon detection, SFA issued directions to recall the products, given the food safety concerns to consumers who are allergic to peanuts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: SFA has not received feedback or information on adverse health effects arising from these cases.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: All these five cases came from overseas, all over the world.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As Members know, we import 90% of our food.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: When they find out that these allergens are not declared, then we do the recall.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: But for Singapore food manufacturing companies, it is a requirement for them to do so.
